description: This file defines API routes for managing and retrieving sponge zone data in a web application. It includes endpoints to get GeoJSON data for sponge zones with filtering options, and to obtain detailed information for specific zones by ID. The code integrates with a Supabase backend for data retrieval, applies input validation and sanitization, and formats the data according to GeoJSON standards.

methods.name: str _sanitize_zone_id(zone_id: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates a zone ID to prevent injection attacks, ensuring it contains only allowed characters and length.

methods.name: SpongeZoneFeature _convert_to_geojson_feature(zone_record: dict)
methods.description: Converts a database record of a zone into a GeoJSON Feature with proper geometry and properties.

methods.name: SpongeZoneCollection get_sponge_zones( request: Request, capacity_category: Optional[str] = Query( None, description="Filter by capacity category: Low, Moderate, High", pattern="^(Low|Moderate|High)$" ), terrain_type: Optional[str] = Query( None, description="Filter by terrain type (e.g., 'Wetland', 'Marsh')", max_length=100 ) )
ZoneDetailResponse get_zone_details( request: Request, zone_id: str = Query( ..., description="Zone identifier (e.g., 'Z001')", min_length=1, max_length=20 ) )
